title: Slave dynasty: lesser rulers and added detail

boxes.title: Careers: more
items: Aibak: born **Turkestan**; first sold to the ==**Qazi of Nishapur**==
Iltutmish: **son-in-law** of Aibak; iqtadar of **Gwalior**, governor of **Baran**, **Badaun**
Razia: male attire, led the army; Altuniya of **Bhatinda (Sirhind)**; ==married Altuniya==, killed **1240**
Balban: Mongol captive bought by Iltutmish; **water-carrier**; Razia made him ==**Amir-i-Shikar**==
Balban crushed **Mewatis**; promoted junior Turks; son **Prince Muhammad** died vs Mongols (**1285**)

boxes.title: Legacy
items: ==First Muslim dynasty to rule north India from Delhi==
Core institutions: iqta, the Forty, **tanka/jital**, Diwan-i-Arz
Quwwat-ul-Islam reused **temple pillars**; Qutb complex now **UNESCO**
